_metadata.selection: 71 canonical workloads; all 77 registered entries Node-verified in pass 1
_metadata.methodology: Three sequential samples per workload, each in a fresh process after one complete fresh-state warmup. Source compilation and fixture preparation precede execution timing. Workload self time and process wall time are stored separately. First pass compares complete output with pinned Node; every subsequent sample runs native correctness checks. Java may continue JIT compilation during measurement.
